THIS PROJECT DOES NOT CLAIM THIS USE IS PERMITTED. The user selected this provider explicitly and knowingly; the choice and this warning are recorded in every run manifest.

bootstrap._comment: Cluster-resampled by parent molecule, because several items derive from one molecule and are not independent.

multiple_comparison._rule: Declared BEFORE the formal run. Within one task the three pairwise comparisons form one family of three, adjusted with Holm-Bonferroni. Comparisons are run only at main scale; smoke is a pipeline check and is not tested for significance.

label_rule._declared: fixed before any main model call and applied only to the frozen item list; a label outside this band is excluded from the main macro-F1 and reported as under-supported, never counted as 1.0. It is NOT a model-driven choice.
label_rule._why_10: below roughly ten positives a per-label F1 is dominated by one or two instances. This is a project-declared floor, not a published convention.
label_rule._label_set_note: recorded offline so scoring averages over the FROZEN set; the earlier scorer re-derived exercised labels from the sample and thereby admitted labels below the declared support floor

budget._comment: Hard stop, enforced in code by runner.Budget. Three counts are kept apart: BASIC REQUESTS (planned items attempted), TRANSPORT ATTEMPTS (every HTTP attempt, so a retry costs one), and COMPLETED ITEMS. 3300 attempts = 3000 basic + ~10% retry headroom.
budget._token_split: max_total_tokens covers prompt + completion + any other billed token the provider reports; max_completion_tokens bounds the completion side separately so an output runaway cannot hide inside the total.
budget._rmb_cap: 30 CNY is ~2x the worst-case busy-hour estimate computed in main_cost_estimate.json; it is a ceiling to stop at, not a forecast.
budget._on_stop: when a cap is hit the runner stops, marks every remaining item 'pending' with the stop reason, and the run is reported as incomplete. Nothing is silently dropped and no partial run may be described as complete.
budget._boundary_honesty: a local guard cannot promise zero overspend: usage is reported by the provider after the fact and the client has no pre-flight token count. The guard is conservative (assume the worst when usage is missing) and the residual risk is stated in main_cost_estimate.json.

resume_and_cache.resume: raw_responses.jsonl is appended per request; re-running the same --run-id skips every example_id already in a terminal state (ok/invalid) and continues
resume_and_cache.rescore_without_spending: `score` and `tables` rebuild metrics from stored responses and never call the model
resume_and_cache.repeats_need_a_new_run: a second pass over the same items must use a new run id; reading the cache and presenting it as a fresh experiment is not allowed
resume_and_cache._retry_policy: retries are transport-only (timeout, connection, 429/5xx). A response that arrived but is wrong is NEVER retried; there is no best-of-N selection anywhere in this runner.

statement: frozen before any main model call. The formal test list is never used to tune prompts, thresholds or scoring rules.
